title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
body: NVIDIA has announced Cosmos-H-Dreams, a generative simulation platform designed to train autonomous surgical robots in high-fidelity virtual environments. The platform leverages real-time physics engines and generative AI to simulate tissue deformation, fluid dynamics, and surgical tool interactions. By enabling robots to practice complex procedures virtually, the system aims to improve safety and precision in surgical automation. This marks a significant milestone in medical robotics, reducing the reliance on physical models during early training phases. NVIDIA's simulation suite provides highly realistic visual grounding.
